snippets.output: Augmentin is not the same thing as amoxicillin; it is a combination antibiotic containing amoxicillin and clavulanic acid.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumerates properties of Augmentin: not same as amoxicillin, combination antibiotic, contains amoxicillin + clavulanic acid.

snippets.output: Amoxicillin is a penicillin-type antibiotic that can treat a variety of bacterial infections.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumerates properties of amoxicillin: drug class and indication.

snippets.output: Clavulanic acid is a beta-lactamase inhibitor that is added to Augmentin to overcome bacterial resistance: certain bacteria produce the enzyme beta-lactamase, which inhibits this enzyme that would otherwise inactivate amoxicillin.
snippets.notes: Pattern B causal chain: clavulanic acid added → mechanism (inhibits beta-lactamase) → why (the enzyme would otherwise inactivate amoxicillin).
snippets.pattern_notes: Pattern B causal chain: clavulanic acid added → inhibits beta-lactamase → would otherwise inactivate amoxicillin.
